title: CI diet: free the GitHub-hosted runner pool for research without weakening any check (data-only PRs run only the tests that read their paths)
note: [2026-10-13 lane CI-DIET] MEASURED over the 48h ending 20:18Z (9,500 runs from the Actions API; job-minutes sampled 6 runs/workflow): PR pytest-run is ~62% of CI job-minutes (502 runs, mean ~36 job-min, ~17.9k min/48h); Guards PR ~2.3k, Guards push ~1.5k, pytest-run push ~1.7k (200 pushes), everything else <1k each. 179 of 233 commits landed on main (77%) touched ONLY research/queue|results, checklist, pipeline, comms, pr-landing/automerge/merge-slot files, yet every one paid the full suite on the PR and again on push (the relevance filter includes those trees because tests read them). FIX 1 (this PR): scripts/ci/pytest_run_scope.py + pytest-run.yml: a data-only diff runs the 155 test files that mention those trees instead of the full suite; non-allowlisted path => full; guards unchanged; check name unchanged. Concurrency-cancel already exists on every PR workflow (3.3k min/48h are partial runs cancelled by newer pushes). NOT changed on purpose: Guards --all on push (post-merge semantic-skew net), push pytest-run for code merges. [2026-10-13 lane CI-DIET] PR1 #17926 MERGED 21:40Z (data-only scope). PR2 (xdist): same tests, -n auto --dist loadfile. Probe runs on branch copies: 14.4 min (first run) vs 33-46 serial; with the two isolation fixes 3 of 3 probe runs green at 11.7/13.0/20.5 min; before the fixes 3 of 3 failed (4 deterministic ml.datasets class-identity failures from tests/test_fetch_backtest_candles_yfinance.py deleting sys.modules without restoring; then 3 MagicMock->Decimal failures from Bybit _LIVE_CACHE/_LOT_CACHE poisoned by mock clients, different files each run). WATCH: any pytest-run failure on a test that passes alone is an isolation bug, fix the test, do not rerun.
